text:
Ravi (CSM): Heads up — Oakridge showing steady drop in DAUs, ~35% over 2 weeks. Renewal in 5w. Proposing a "Lean Save Sprint" focused on three quick levers: onboarding fixes, targeted enablement, and a capped credit.
Lena (CS Ops): I can stand up a short-lived priority flag and suppress automated renewal emails during the sprint.
Noah (Enablement): I’ll prep three 90-second clips: setup microtask, reporting tweak, and admin checklist. Also a one-page 'what to run this week' for end-users.
Sam (AE): They mentioned churn risk triggered by executive skepticism around ROI. Small, time-bound concession (e.g., $60 credit) usually calms execs. Keep it simple.
Ivy (Analytics): Quick cohort: seats added in last 60 days have 2x lower feature hits. I'll push a mini-dashboard and a CSV to the ticket.
NotifyBot: Playbook template applied: lean_save_sprint_v2 (pid: ls_202).
Ravi (CSM): Proposed cadence: Day0 touch + schedule; Day2 micro enablement call (15m); Day4 hands-on walk; Day7 pulse + credit if no lift; Day10 exec note. Keep outreach brief.
Lena (CS Ops): Ops checklist: tag `lean_save=true`, set support priority window for 7 days, clear billing hold rules for quick credits.
Noah (Enablement): Draft email subject: "15 min plan to recover [KPI] this week". Will add one-click calendar link.
Sam (AE): I'll draft the credit line: "If activation metric doesn't improve by 25% within 7 days, eligible for a one-time $60 account credit." Sending to legal ASAP.
Ivy (Analytics): Adding alert: if 7d rolling activation doesn't increase by 20% by Day5, auto-notify the sprint channel and owner.
Ravi (CSM): Action items: Noah assets by EOD; Ivy dashboard today; Lena ops toggles today; Sam credit legal ping tomorrow. I'll begin outreach tomorrow morning.
Lena (CS Ops): Scheduling quick 20-min sync tomorrow 10am PT to finalize triggers and tagging.
Noah (Enablement): I'll upload the 90-sec vids before the sync.
Ivy (Analytics): Uploaded cohort CSV to ticket and created widget.
Ravi (CSM): Thanks team — aim to have first touches out by tomorrow so we have full sprint before renewal outreach. Keep notes in the ticket. :rocket:
